items.title: 5.11 General properties of solids (solids ki aam properties) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.11, printed page 109.

blocks.text: Solid ke atoms, molecules ya ions bohat qareeb qareeb bhare hote hain; gas ki tarah yeh aur qareeb nahi aa sakte. Metallic solids mein atoms gend (sphere) jaise gol hote hain. Aise particles ko arrange karne se hexagonal aur cubic close-packed structures bante hain. In mein particles ki outer boundaries (bahar ki hadein) ek doosre ko chhoo rahi hoti hain, magar gol hone ki wajah se woh 74% se zyada jagah nahi bhar sakte. Matlab solid ko aur compress karna (dabana) possible nahi.
